title: OpenAI - Some ChatGPT content may be unavailable on Android
text:
Service: OpenAI
Incident: Some ChatGPT content may be unavailable on Android
Status: resolved
Impact: major
Started: None
Resolved: 2026-10-10T00:26:44Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-10T00:26:44Z: resolved - All impacted services have now fully recovered.
- 2026-10-09T21:00:39Z: identified - We have identified an issue affecting the ChatGPT Android app where users may see “This content is unavailable in this version of the app” instead of certain content. A fix is rolling out gradually in the latest Android version. Users can use ChatGPT on the web while we work to restore the experience for older app versions.
